scope: All46 approved named-land entries assigned to Europe/Asia, including existing represented and omitted branches. Not regional interior audit.

shoreline.name: GSHHG 2.3.7 full-resolution binary, ocean land outer coastlines
shoreline.source_vintage: Release2.3.7 2017-06-15; WVS/WDBII composite antecedents, not a 2026 survey. README explicitly notes offsets from modern GPS; lake origins may use WGS072.
shoreline.license: GNU Lesser General Public License v3; exact LICENSE.TXT/COPYING.LESSERv3 retained
shoreline.restoration: Download pinned archive and verify SHA256, extract gshhs_f.b and verify binarySHA; original shared archive unchanged.

gazetteer.name: Wikipedia105 named article pages, original-byte SHA/revision/attribution retained
gazetteer.license: CC BY-SA article text, attributed via articleURL and authors/history; name/coordinate assertions not licensed shoreline substitutes

geonames.source_country_zip_restoration: RawZIPs retainedinexecutioncache; manifestpinsURL andfullZIPdigest, exact selectedsourceTSVlines arearchivedhere. Source modificationtimestamps arenotobservationdates.

method.area: WGS84 geodesic polygon area via pyproj.Geod with oriented exterior/interior rings and positive land-part sums; sourceoutercomponent may enclose lake/lagoon water because level2 lake mask not subtracted. This is shoreline extent evaluation, not ownership land denominators.
method.longitude: Native microdegree coordinates independently unwrapped then translated into [-180,180) neighborhood; rings retained, invalid source corrected only in audit normalization with originalbytes untouched.
method.header_area: GSHHG magnitude scaling decoded area /10**((flag>>26)&63); actual polygon area drives measurements.
method.window_selection: Declared window intersection plus componentarea bounds excludes continental mainlands for named oceanislands; whole source polygons retained. MAINLANDtwoentries explicitly clipped and cannot certify wholepeninsula.
method.named_assignment: Primary article coordinate identifies source component only when inside. Nearestcomponent candidates (<0.04deg) retain uncertainty. Wholepolygon targetshare separately measured; archipelago-centre point cannot certify family.
method.representation: Strict>50% of sourcewholeoutercomponent in targetregion means majority-represented component only, not a coastlineexact certificate. No-majority sourcewindow candidates stayprovisional.
method.offset_diagnostic: Local WGS84 AEQD targetneighborhood buffer200m usedonly diagnostically; originalsource/currentgeometry unchanged. Larger historicaloffsets remainconfounds until modern independentshoreline checked.
